title: Live: Trump announces plan to refine, sell up to 50 million barrels of Venezuelan oil
summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday unveiled a plan to refine and sell up to 50 million barrels of Venezuelan oil that had been stuck ⁠in Venezuela under US blockade, in a further sign that Washington is coordinating with the Venezuelan government since capturing President Nicolas Maduro. Read our blog to see how the day's events unfolded.
